test_cases.description: The manifest files array must contain every specific ScaffoldFilePath variant as an exact string, not just have length 12
The manifest files array must not contain any paths outside the ScaffoldFilePath enum — no extra entries allowed
assertions: every file in manifest.files is a member of ScaffoldFilePath enum

test_cases.description: The manifest projectRoot field must be a non-empty string representing a path
getProjectManifest must return a new object each call or the returned object must not be shared mutable state — mutating one result must not affect future calls
assertions: mutating returned manifest does not affect subsequent calls

test_cases.description: Each dependency must have its exact specified caret range, not just any string starting with ^
The dependencies array must contain only the 3 specified packages — no unexpected extras
assertions: dependencies array packageNames are exactly react, react-dom, react-router-dom

test_cases.description: The devDependencies array must contain only the 13 specified packages — no unexpected extras
assertions: devDependencies packageNames are exactly the 13 specified packages

test_cases.description: generateScaffold must create the src/ subdirectory within the output directory for files that live under src/
assertions: src/ directory exists after scaffold generation

test_cases.description: Generated package.json must declare every dependency from getRequiredDependencies with matching version ranges, not just have type:module
assertions: package.json dependencies object contains react, react-dom, react-router-dom with correct versions
package.json devDependencies object contains all 13 dev packages with correct versions

test_cases.description: Generated package.json must be valid parseable JSON, not just a string containing keywords
assertions: parsed result is an object with dependencies and devDependencies keys

test_cases.description: Generated vercel.json must be valid parseable JSON with the correct structural shape
assertions: parsed result has rewrites array of length 1

test_cases.description: Generated vite.config.ts must configure test.globals = true for Vitest global API availability
assertions: vite.config.ts content includes globals: true or equivalent

test_cases.description: Generated vite.config.ts must configure test.setupFiles to include ./vitest.setup.ts
assertions: vite.config.ts content includes setupFiles referencing vitest.setup.ts

test_cases.description: Generated vite.config.ts must configure resolve.alias mapping '@' to the src directory using import.meta.dirname
assertions: vite.config.ts contains resolve alias with '@' key

test_cases.description: Generated vite.config.ts must import and use @vitejs/plugin-react
Generated postcss.config.mjs must export both tailwindcss and autoprefixer plugins
Generated src/main.tsx must render the App component into the #root DOM element
assertions: src/main.tsx contains createRoot or render call

test_cases.description: Generated src/main.tsx must import React from 'react' as its first import statement
assertions: first import line in src/main.tsx is React from 'react'

test_cases.description: The ScaffoldResult.manifest must contain all 12 ScaffoldFilePath entries and match the canonical manifest structure
Every generated file must have non-empty content — no zero-byte placeholder files
Generated tsconfig.json must be valid parseable JSON with expected TypeScript compiler options
Generated tsconfig.node.json must be valid parseable JSON distinct from tsconfig.json
generateScaffold must work with arbitrary valid output directory paths, not just a hardcoded path
assertions: scaffold succeeds with a different temp directory name
all 12 files written at the new path

test_cases.description: Generated index.html should be a valid HTML document structure, not just contain the required div and script tags as fragments
Generated package.json should include a 'name' field matching the project name from the manifest
validateScaffold must detect when package.json exists but has missing or incorrect dependencies
assertions: validation reports invalid when package.json has missing dependencies

test_cases.description: When overwrite is true and files exist with different content, the scaffold must actually replace them with correct content, not just skip
assertions: after overwrite, package.json has correct content not the pre-existing garbage content

test_cases.description: Generated vite.config.ts must configure test.environment specifically as 'jsdom', not 'happy-dom' or other alternatives
assertions: vite.config.ts contains environment setting with jsdom value

test_cases.description: src/App.tsx must have a named export called 'App' specifically, not just any named export alongside a default
assertions: src/App.tsx contains 'export function App' or 'export const App'

test_cases.description: getRequiredDependencies must return independent objects each call — mutating one result must not affect subsequent calls
assertions: mutating returned deps does not affect subsequent calls

test_cases.description: generateScaffold should reject an outputDir that contains only whitespace as invalid
